newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville leaves Thursday power offers unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville leaves Thursday power offers unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left next-day offer prices unchanged, the federal agency said Wednesday.
BPA also continued to refrain from offering non-firm power during morning and evening peaks and from offering any displacement power for Thursday.
BPA still offered up to 300 megawatts of firm peak power on Thursday at $16.75 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $17.75 for California-Oregon border (COB).
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Thursday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
Non-firm shoulder hour (0600, 1100-1700 and 2100-2300 PST) offers for Thursday were unchanged at $10.50 for Northwest and $11.50 for COB.
